units.source_text: 偶尔我也有过梦遗，但是没有实在的色欲的影像，譬如我梦见一只黑狗在黑暗的市街上奔跑，它张着火焰般的嘴在喘气。

en.t: Sometimes I had wet dreams too, but they contained no concrete images of sexual desire; for example, I dreamed of a black dog running through a dark city street, panting with its flame-like mouth open.

units.source_text: 随着挂在它的脖颈上的铃铛不停地鸣响，我更加亢奋，铃裆声达到极度时，我便射精了。

en.t: As the bell hanging from its neck kept ringing, I grew more and more excited, and when the sound of the bell reached its peak, I ejaculated.
